text: Reporting a benchmark at peak throughput without stating ___ — the ratio of delivered to peak operations on a named workload — is called astrology; GPUs run 40-70% of it on large GEMMs but only single-digit percent on small kernels.
explanation: Utilization = R_delivered / R_peak must be reported or the benchmark is meaningless; peak-for-delivered substitution is a named audit pitfall. Photonic cores have their own utilization discounts, so fair comparison must be delivered-to-delivered on a named workload at stated accuracy.
